art_note: Clean studio product shots with accurate lighting, though slightly elevated by standard supplier render aesthetics.
desc_en: A refined expression of contemporary design. This backpack is crafted from waterproof synthetic leather featuring a contrasted floral motif. Its structured silhouette balances functionality with a minimalist aesthetic. It features a zippered main compartment and a discrete front pocket to organize daily essentials. The design is completed with adjustable straps and a fixed top handle.
desc_es: Una expresión depurada de diseño contemporáneo. Esta mochila está confeccionada en cuero sintético impermeable con un motivo floral contrastado. Su silueta estructurada equilibra la funcionalidad con una estética minimalista. Cuenta con un compartimento principal con cierre y un bolsillo frontal discreto para organizar los esenciales diarios. El diseño se completa con correas ajustables y un asa superior fija.
